answer: A payout is split and hence 28% arrives at settlement and the rest over 10 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The anchor schedule is applied in haven and wharf exposes each instalment. Someone as a result cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 1101 identities would post 4501 proofs and burn roughly 53 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
